description: In common/mod.rs:2478, the parsability check uses text.contains("Disposition:") which is case-sensitive. RFC 5322 header names are case-insensitive. A conforming MDN blob with 'disposition: ...' (lowercase) will be classified as notParsable instead of being parsed. The subsequent find_header_value call at line 2557 is correctly case-insensitive (eq_ignore_ascii_case), creating an inconsistency: the gate is strict, the parser is lenient. Impact: any real-world MDN blob from a mail client that lowercases header names would fail to parse in test infrastructure and in production if this backend is used as a reference.
title: mdn parse_mdns: case-sensitive Disposition: heuristic
